description: This file defines a singleton helper class 'RefreshBroadcast' used for broadcasting refresh requests within a Blazor admin panel. It provides an event-based mechanism to notify components that a refresh should occur.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A thread-safe singleton class facilitating event broadcasting for refresh requests within the Blazor admin interface.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Triggers the 'RefreshRequested' event if any subscribers are registered.
